instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: InnovateFlow SaaS develops B2B workflow automation software tailored for logistics companies. We leverage AI to optimize supply chain routes and inventory management, targeting mid-sized enterprises globally.
answers.pastInitiatives: In the last year, we successfully launched three core product modules and completed a major platform migration to a cloud infrastructure provider. These initiatives were driven by internal roadmap planning.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is aggressive market share expansion in emerging international logistics markets over the next five years. We aim to increase Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) by 150% through strategic product diversification and rapid scaling.
answers.teamSize: The core engineering team consists of 20 highly skilled developers, supported by a small dedicated product management unit that collaborates cross-functionally on new feature development.
answers.additionalContext: The market is rapidly evolving with entrants focusing on hyper-specialized AI tools, requiring constant innovation to maintain a competitive edge.

opportunities.title: Launch Hyper-Personalized Predictive Maintenance Module (AI Overlay)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a radical AI overlay that integrates real-time IoT data from logistics partners will move us beyond simple route optimization into proactive, predictive maintenance planning. This is necessary to capture premium enterprise contracts and justify aggressive growth.

first_actions: Pilot the Predictive Maintenance algorithm on 5 anchor clients in Q3
Establish a dedicated data science sprint team focused solely on this feature
resources_needed: Cloud computing credits for high-volume simulation testing ($50k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 30% reduction in client downtime reported by pilot users within six months.

opportunities.title: Expand API Ecosystem for Third-Party Integrations
opportunities.rationale: To drive rapid growth, we must broaden our integration capabilities beyond existing enterprise partners. This incremental move ensures platform stickiness and opens new revenue streams through marketplace integrations.

first_actions: Audit current API documentation for gaps in common industry workflows
Launch a dedicated Partner Onboarding Program (M1-M3)
resources_needed: Contract with an external integration specialist firm ($40k)
Allocate 50 hours/week from existing development team
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase the number of unique third-party integrations by 50% in one year.

next_steps.action: Conduct detailed feasibility study and resource allocation plan for the Predictive Maintenance Module.
Formalize the KPI framework and establish governance structure for high-risk projects.
Initiate Q3 Data Science Sprint to build initial MVP prototype foundation.

key_weaknesses: Reliance on a small, highly specialized engineering team leading to potential single-point-of-failure risk.
Scaling infrastructure costs quickly as user load increases (cost inefficiency).
Slow internal communication channels between product development and sales teams causing feature misalignment.
